intro: Bangladesh has grown fast, built on clothing factories, farming and money sent home by workers abroad.

chapters.title: Made in Bangladesh
text: Bangladesh is one of the world's biggest exporters of clothing, second after China. Millions of workers, most of them women, sew clothes for global brands.
In 2013 the Rana Plaza factory building collapsed near Dhaka, killing more than 1,100 people. It led to new safety agreements.

chapters.title: Growing fast
text: Rice, jute and fish are big parts of farming. Bangladesh pioneered microcredit, small loans to poor people, through the Grameen Bank. The Padma Bridge, opened in 2022, linked the south-west to Dhaka by road.

keyTerms.meaning: Very small loans to help people start businesses.
